value.title: Very Good

value.author: Padideh
value.title: Nie wieder. Überhaupt nicht empfehlenswert. Alle Sternen sind gekauft. Das Hotel ist schlimm .
value.text: Nichts . Es war einfach eine Katastrophe . Respektlose Personal, keine Ordentliche Frühstück. Zimmerreinigung war nicht akzeptabel.

value.text:
L'emplacement, la propreté et le personnel
— Beaucoup de bruit devant la chambre

value.author: Mahmoud
value.title: Very noisy from the street music
value.text: Only one of the staff members the other don’t have any experience

value.author: Ramin
value.title: Pleasant stay , helpfull staffs, Great location
value.text:
Very helpful and welcoming staffs , clean rooms , it worths its price i stayed there 7nights and  for sure i will choose this hotel again
— Just a small thing about invoice where the hotel was not providing invoice due to booking from booking.com and they said i should get invoice from booking.com where normally it comes from property during tgese ling years tgat i am using and booking hotels from booking.com platform 
I should also that reception lady said she will do her best to resolve it with management if possible

value.author: Az-eddine
value.title: Je ne recommande pas, c’est du mensonge ce qu est ecris dans la description.
value.text:
Lemplacement
— 122$/nuite, sans petit dejeuner, et sans connexion Wifi dans les chambres, quand jai appele pour le réclamer il mont dis que c un ancien hotel, j’ai demandé de leau, il ne l’ont même ramené, bref, un très mauvais hotel pour ce prix. Un hôtels 5* avec un service nulle, vraiment pensez 1000 fois avant d’y aller

value.author: Farzad
value.title: استف و پرسنل خوبی دارن
value.text:
خیلی کمک کردن و پرسنل خیلی خوبی داشتن
— همه چی خوب بود

value.author: Paddy-k
value.title: Pleasant
value.text:
The room was big,  bed was comfortable,  staff at frount counter were very pleasant and efficient . Very convenient location for airport transfer bus.
— Poor access into hotel with luggage, noise from outside hotel could always be heard, got woken up early every morning 😞 rooms are big but dated and showing their age. Lifts are small.  The area surrounding the hotel is full of restaurants and cafes that absolutely pester tourists,  the city has great restaurants and cafes elsewhere

value.author: Venus
value.title: Not recommend for Victory Day but fair in total
value.text:
The view was good although due to victory day they covered our window with a long flag that blocked even the sunshine
— One of toilet fans didn’t work properly and it is almost non usable 
Additionally don’t recommend here for Victory Day (even if you paid more for a good view they would block all your viewing)!
